open_points.subject: A05/K-06 file media-type equality in proof and wiring
open_points.question: When comparing file media types across ports (proof phase 3, edge validity, and other "same media type" checks), is equality exact string equality, or MIME-normalized (case-insensitive type/subtype, parameter handling)?
options: Exact byte/string equality of the declared media_type
Case-insensitive comparison of type/subtype only, ignore parameters
Normalize media types first (e.g., lowercase + parameter normalization) then compare
open_points.default_guess: Exact string equality of declared media_type.

open_points.subject: A04 rule 6 try-implementation refusal precedence
open_points.text: "A request naming an unknown case, a case of another contract version, or one case twice is refused before anything executes, and so is a try on an empty corpus, as `empty_corpus`."
open_points.question: If the corpus is empty and the request also names explicit (therefore unknown) cases, which refusal is returned first?
options: Return `empty_corpus` first as a global precondition
Return unknown/foreign/duplicate-case refusal first by validating named cases before corpus emptiness
Define an explicit fixed order among these refusal checks
open_points.default_guess: Check corpus emptiness first and return `empty_corpus`.

open_points.subject: A14/A11 startup recovery of multiple `in_flight` attempts
open_points.text: "On start, before the surface accepts a request, the kernel turns every `in_flight` EffectAttempt into `unknown`..." and "...one call per attempt."
open_points.question: In what deterministic order are multiple `in_flight` attempts processed at startup (across runs and within a run)?
options: Group by run (run order), then by node/map_index/attempt_number
open_points.default_guess: Process in global store order (oldest first).
